The filing attributes a project-cost revision to work stoppage, schedule changes, and unusually high rainfall. Retrieval family is not a semantic label, and the source does not isolate a single controlled event family.

evidence.excerpt: RGC Midstream, LLC ("Midstream"), a wholly-owned subsidiary of RGC Resources, Inc. (the "Company") is a 1% investor in the Mountain Valley Pipeline, LLC (the "LLC").  On September 24, 2018, the LLC issued a press release updating the projected project cost of the Mountain Valley Pipeline to $4.6 billion from its prior estimated cost of $3.7 billion.  The increase in costs is attributable to periods of work stoppage and schedule changes combined with the unusually high rainfall totals over the last few months.  As a result of the LLC's revised cost projections, Midstream's cash investment is expected to increase to $46 million, or 1% of the total project cost.

items.rationale: The 8-K states MVP projected cost rose to $4.6 billion from $3.7 billion and Midstream cash investment is expected to increase to $46 million.
